# scoop-boot package list for the WSL Debian distribution (delivered by
# scoop-boot.ps1 --update; do not edit): the devel profile, used when
# etc\packages\<hostname>.debian.txt does not exist. One apt package per line; "#"
# starts a comment. --wsl-setup installs the packages that are missing, with
# --no-install-recommends. --profile composes etc\packages\<hostname>.debian.txt
# from the profiles under etc\profiles: it replaces this file completely and is
# never touched by --update. Claude Code is not an apt package: --wsl-setup installs
# it with the official installer after the list (skip with --no-claude).
# Profiles: base, desktop, ide, cli, svn, java, node, perl, python, c++, docs, network, db, server, azure, media
# ---- profile base ----
# Base system and certificates
ca-certificates
curl
wget
gnupg
unzip
zip
xz-utils
locales
sudo

# Version control
git
git-lfs
openssh-client

# ---- profile cli ----
# Command line tools
jq
yq
ripgrep
fd-find
bat
less
tree
htop
tmux
vim
shellcheck

# ---- profile java ----
# Java
default-jdk-headless
maven

# ---- profile python ----
# Python
python3
python3-venv
python3-pip
pipx

# ---- profile c++ ----
# Build tools
build-essential
make
cmake
ninja-build
pkg-config

# ---- profile network ----
# Network
bind9-dnsutils
iputils-ping
netcat-openbsd
openssl
